title: [groq] drop chain-of-thought if assistant messages end with use of final channel
body:
Placeholder issue to implement https://cookbook.openai.com/articles/openai-harmony#handling-reasoning-output-in-subsequent-sampling

In particular with groq + gpt-oss models.

We created a preliminary pull request with an example to reproduce the problem and some pointers where the change most likely needs to happen: https://github.com/vercel/ai/pull/7895

linked_prs.title: fix(groq): send reasoning input
linked_prs.body:
## Background

OpenAI recommends to pass reasoning with function calls if present, see https://cookbook.openai.com/articles/openai-harmony#handling-reasoning-output-in-subsequent-sampling

## Summary

If reasoning is present, send the last one along with the function call.
